verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: The all-merciful and beneficent Father has bowels [of compassion] towards those that fear Him, and kindly and lovingly bestows His favours upon those who come to Him with a simple mind.
verses.modernizedText: The all-merciful and beneficent Father has compassion for those who fear Him, and kindly and lovingly bestows His favors upon those who come to Him with a simple mind.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Wherefore let us not be double-minded; neither let our soul be lifted up on account of His exceedingly great and glorious gifts.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore let us not be double-minded, nor let our soul be lifted up because of His exceedingly great and glorious gifts.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Far from us be that which is written, “Wretched are they who are of a double mind, and of a doubting heart; who say, These things we have heard even in the times of our fathers; but, behold, we have grown old, and none of them has happened unto us;” Ye foolish ones! compare yourselves to a tree; take [for instance] the vine.
verses.modernizedText: Far from us be what is written, “Wretched are those who are double-minded and of a doubting heart, who say, These things we heard even in the days of our fathers; but, behold, we have grown old, and none of them has happened to us.” You foolish ones! Compare yourselves to a tree; take [for instance] the vine.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: First of all, it sheds its leaves, then it buds, next it puts forth leaves, and then it flowers; after that comes the sour grape, and then follows the ripened fruit.
verses.modernizedText: First it sheds its leaves, then it buds, next it puts forth leaves, and then it flowers; after that comes the sour grape, and then the ripened fruit.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Ye perceive how in a little time the fruit of a tree comes to maturity.
verses.modernizedText: You perceive how in a short time the fruit of a tree comes to maturity.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Of a truth, soon and suddenly shall His will be accomplished, as the Scripture also bears witness, saying, “Speedily will He come, and will not tarry;” and, “The Lord shall suddenly come to His temple, even the Holy One, for whom ye look.”
verses.modernizedText: Truly, soon and suddenly His will will be accomplished, as the Scripture also bears witness, saying, “He will come speedily and will not delay,” and, “The Lord will suddenly come to His temple, even the Holy One for whom you look.”
